purpose: Hard-vs-soft exudate decision boundary, FITTED on the IDRiD training split. Read by loadExudateSplit.
objective: max soft F1 s.t. hard precision >= 0.50; falls back to max hard recall when soft cannot clear the reporting gate at any boundary
ruleApplied: soft unreportable at every boundary -> maximise hard recall subject to hard precision >= 0.50
note: Fitted on IDRiD train (n=54). Soft-exudate precision peaks at 0.107 across the whole sweep, far below the 0.50 reporting gate, so the soft channel is a detector-level failure rather than a threshold choice and stays hidden. The boundary was therefore set to favour the displayable channel: hard precision 0.692, recall 0.142.
